Our first meta-day

So, the time has come, it's now Sunday, meaning it is the very first meta-day of ModernPowers. This means that for the entirety of Sunday (we use GMT as the time in ModernPowers) you may only post [Meta], [News] and [Roleplay] posts that do not affect the game. Today is only a day of discussion and socializing that does not affect the gameplay of the subverse. Of course, [Claim] posts by new users are always allowed.

CSS confusion

Earlier in the day we ran out of space in the CSS stylesheet (see here), however /u/LegoMyEgo helped to fix this (see here), meaning user flairs now take up much less code in the Stylesheet, and we have room for many new players (my guess is that we will become full if we hit around 100 players, but that number is fine).

New moderators

Please welcome our newest moderators:

  • @PM_ME_YOUR_ARCHES
  • @Boukert

Essential information

  • If you would like to have your own custom user flair/text, see underneath the meta category in the sidebar. Make sure that if you would like to enable a flag as your flair, that the flag is a visible rectangle (ultimately it must resize nicely to 16x11 pixels, which works if it's just a visible rectangle). So no circles or squares please, just plain old rectangles.

  • Since our moderation team is very large now, we will be inviting less people to it than before. Seven moderators will last this subverse for a long time.

  • Just because a country is in ModernPowers, this does not mean you have to recognize it. I (Greenland) was not fully recognized as a country until I held my referendum. So you don't have to recognize ISIS if you don't want to, but he is still playing, and he still exists.

  • We don't discriminate - if you want to place the apartheid into your country, or want to make a deal with the cartels to kill innocent civilians (Jamaica) that's fine. As long as you do it with realism in mind (and abide by the rules, and are not offensive) you can do what you want with your country. REMEMBER HOWEVER, there is a limit. No holocausts, or anything of that nature.
